items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, that's what Budd Johnson was saying. The last time we were in the Soviet Union, Bud was there.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's what Budd Johnson was saying. The last time we were in the Soviet Union, Bud was there. And we were in a foreigners dining room and some African revolutionaries came up. They had outfits and everything and gave the Communist salute and started calling him "Brother" and how did he like it when he was in the land of freedom, and so forth. Budd looked at them and said, "Man, I would rather be back in Mississippi starving."
